name: COHERENT Collaboration
notes: host_facility_id and host_site_id are dangling references: facility:oak-ridge-national-laboratory and site:ornl-sns-neutrino-alley are owned by the facilities workstream and do not exist yet in this repo as of 2026-09-17.
member_count (a headcount of individual scientists) is not stated on the official collaboration page, which gives only institution and country counts; left null per A17 rather than estimated.
Institution-level membership rows are owned by the membership-lead workstream and are not written here.
Leadership is left empty: no fetched source states current spokesperson(s); person records are also owned by another workstream.
Derived field collaboration.experiment_ids is deliberately not written (v0.2 A1).

summary.plain: The international team of physicists who built and run the COHERENT experiment: 21 institutions in 4 countries, formed in 2013 to measure how neutrinos scatter off whole atomic nuclei.
summary.technical: COHERENT Collaboration, formed 2013 at the Shull Wollan Center; 21 member institutions across 4 countries (USA, Russia, Canada, South Korea) per the collaboration's own site as of 2026.
